name: Staggered Slats Transition
description: Staggered strips reveal the scene with a long, smooth decay.

settings.label: Play on entry
settings.description: Replay the entrance on mount and settings changes. Disable for manually triggered navigation.

settings.label: Heading
settings.description: Demo headline. Line breaks are preserved; custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Caption
settings.default:
Set the tone before the first scroll.
Make every arrival feel considered.
settings.description: Demo supporting copy. Custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Canvas
settings.description: Receiving canvas behind the demo image. Visible while the image loads or wherever content leaves the canvas uncovered.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: Base color for the demo headline, supporting copy and credit. The replay action and overlay labels use their own colors.

settings.label: Cover
settings.description: Opaque cover and reveal layer color.

settings.label: Minimum height
settings.description: Minimum receiving area height in pixels. The layout follows its container width.

settings.label: Desktop reveal
settings.description: Incoming strip travel in milliseconds at desktop widths. Below 1200px, Responsive slats replaces this with Compact duration; disable it to use this value everywhere.

settings.label: Navigation cover
settings.description: Outgoing cover duration in milliseconds. Applies to Next scene, cover() and navigate(), not Replay reveal.

settings.label: Desktop stagger
settings.description: Incoming delay in milliseconds between adjacent strips at desktop widths. Below 1200px, Responsive slats replaces this with Compact stagger.

settings.label: Covered hold
settings.description: Covered pause in milliseconds after Entry delay, before the first strip moves.

settings.label: Entry delay
settings.description: Initial reveal delay in milliseconds. Navigation cover uses its separate duration.

settings.label: Number of slats
settings.description: Incoming strip count at desktop widths. Below 1200px, Responsive slats overrides this with six strips; disable it to use your chosen count everywhere.

settings.label: Motion curve
settings.description: Incoming strip movement curve. Long decay starts quickly and settles gradually; navigation cover keeps its own smooth curve when Long decay is selected.

settings.label: Slat direction
settings.description: Incoming movement direction at desktop widths. Below 1200px, Responsive slats overrides this with downward motion; disable it to use your chosen direction everywhere.

settings.label: Responsive slats
settings.description: At receiving widths below 1200px, use six downward strips and Compact duration/stagger instead of desktop count, direction and timing. Disable for identical settings at every width.

settings.label: Compact slat duration
settings.description: Reveal duration in milliseconds below 1200px, only when responsive slats is enabled.

settings.label: Compact slat stagger
settings.description: Strip delay in milliseconds below 1200px, only when responsive slats is enabled.
